title: PREPARING FOR THE SHIFT GOD IS ABOUT TO MAKE IN MY LIFE
text: In the mighty name of Jesus, I want you to share this word with somebody. Send it to that friend, that family member, that colleague who needs to hear what the spirit of God is saying in this season. There are people in your circle who are standing at the edge of a divine transition. And this word will be the catalyst that breaks them into their next dimension. Share it now in Jesus name. I come to you today under a heavy burden of the spirit. There is a shift that God is orchestrating and I need you to pay attention because what I'm about to share with you is not entertainment. This is instruction from the throne room [music] of heaven. The spirit of the Lord has been dealing with me concerning the nature of transition, concerning the process of divine elevation and concerning what it takes for a man or woman to successfully navigate the shift that God is about to make in their life. You see beloved, every believer will experience seasons of shift. These are divine interruptions orchestrated by the wisdom of God to reposition you for greater glory, greater influence, and greater capacity to carry his presence. But here is what many people don't understand. Not everyone who enters a season of shift successfully completes it. There are men and women who God began to elevate, but they could not sustain the process. They could not endure the preparation. They could not survive the pressures that come with transition when God is about to shift you. He doesn't just change your circumstances, he changes you. This is what many believers miss. They are praying for promotion, but they are not prepared for transformation. They want the blessing, but they don't want the breakin. They want the new wine, but they don't want to become a new wine scheme. And so they enter into seasons of shift, but they abort the process because they cannot handle what God is doing in them before he does something for them. I want you to understand something tonight. The shift God is about to make in your life will require a shift in your spirit. It will require a shift in your mentality. It will require a shift in your level of consecration. You cannot carry tomorrow's glory with yesterday's character. You cannot steward next level blessings with current level discipline. God is preparing you for what he has prepared for you. And the preparation is not optional. The Bible says in 1 Samuel chapter 16 that when Samuel came to anoint David, he had to pass through seven brothers before he got to the eighth. Why? Because God was making a statement about the nature of divine selection. God does not choose based on what man sees. Man looks at the outward appearance, but God looks at the heart. And when God was ready to shift the government of Israel from Saul to David, he didn't just look for someone who was talented. He didn't just look for someone who was educated. He didn't just look for someone who had connections. He looked for someone whose heart was postured correctly. This is critical, beloved. Before God shifts your position, he examines your posture. Before he changes your location, he evaluates your heart. David was in the wilderness tending sheep, worshiping in obscurity, fighting lions and bears that nobody saw, developing a relationship with God that nobody knew about. And it was in that place of hiddenness that God was preparing him for a throne. So when you are praying for God to shift, you understand that the shift begins in the secret place. It begins in your prayer life. It begins in your worship. It begins in how you handle yourself when no one is watching. God is looking for people whose private devotion matches [music] their public declaration. He's looking for people who are as committed in the wilderness as they claim they will be on the throne. I prophesy over your life right now. Every hour you have invested in secret prayer will become public testimony. Every tear you have swn in the place of intercession will produce a harvest of breakthrough. Every moment you have spent seeking God's face when you could have been chasing opportunities will position you for divine connections [music] that money cannot buy the shift is coming but it is coming to those who have prepared their hearts. Now I need to take you deeper. When God is preparing you for a shift he will often allow you to go through seasons of pressure. This is not punishment. This is preparation. Pressure is the environment where character is forged. Pressure is the atmosphere where dependency on God is developed. Pressure is the classroom where you learn to trust God beyond what you can see, beyond what you can feel, beyond what makes sense. Look at Joseph. Genesis chapter 37 to chapter 50 is a masterclass in divine shift. Joseph had a dream, but between the dream and the fulfillment was a process that almost killed him. He was betrayed by his brothers, sold into slavery, falsely accused, thrown into prison, forgotten by those he helped. But what you need to understand is that every level of that pressure was preparing him for Pharaoh's palace. The pit was preparing him for the palace. The prison was preparing him for power. The betrayal was teaching him how to handle authority without bitterness. And so when you find yourself under pressure, when you find yourself in situations that don't make sense, when it looks like everything is falling apart, I need you to shift your perspective. What if God is not punishing you? What if God is positioning you? What if this is not an attack? What if this is an assignment? What if the enemy is not winning? What if God is working? The Bible says that all things work together [music] for good to those who love God and are called according to his purpose. This means that even the betrayals are working for you. Even the delays are working for you. Even the disappointments are [music] working for you. God is weaving everything together to position you for the shift he has ordained. But let me tell you something that will revolutionize your understanding. The shift God is preparing for you is not just about you. This is where many believers get it wrong. They think God wants to bless them so they can live comfortably. They think God wants to promote them so they can enjoy prestige. But God's shifts are always connected to assignment. God positions you so he can use you. He elevates you so he can extend his kingdom through you. When God shifted Abraham, he said, "I will bless you and make your name greater and you will be a blessing." The blessing was not the end. It was the means. When God shifted Moses from the backside of the desert to the palace of Pharaoh, it was not for Moses' personal enjoyment. It was for the deliverance of a nation. When God shifted Esther from obscurity to royalty, it was not for her comfort. It was for such a time as that, for the preservation of her people. So the question you need to ask yourself tonight is, am I preparing for a shift so I can be comfortable? Or am I preparing for a shift so I can be useful? Am I positioning myself for promotion so I can be served or so I can serve? Because if your motivation is wrong, God may delay your shift until your heart is right. God will not release you into influence if you are going to use that influence for selfish purposes. This is why consecration is so important. Consecration is the process of separating yourself unto God, of positioning your heart in alignment with his heart, of saying, "Lord, whatever you want to do in me and through me, I surrender." And let me tell you something, consecration is not popular. In a generation that is obsessed with speed, convenience, and shortcuts, consecration requires patience. It requires discipline. It requires sacrifice. But show me a person who is truly consecrated. And I will show you a person who is a candidate for divine shift. Show me someone who has learned to fast when others are feasting, who has learned to pray when others are playing, who has learned to study the word when others are scrolling through social media. And I will show you someone that God is preparing for unprecedented elevation. There's something I want you to catch in the spirit. When God is about to shift you, he will often surround you with people who don't understand you. This is strategic. The isolation you feel is not rejection. [music] It is protection. God is separating you from voices that would contaminate your vision. He's removing you from relationships that would compete with your assignment. He's positioning you in a place where you have no choice but to depend on him. David experienced this even after he was anointed king. He spent years running from Saul, hiding in caves, misunderstood by his own family, rejected by the establishment. But in that season of isolation, God was doing something powerful. He was disconnecting David from the system of Saul so he wouldn't replicate it when he became king. He was teaching David how to worship in the wilderness so he would know how to govern from the throne. So if you feel isolated right now, if you feel like nobody understands what God is doing in your life, if you feel like you're in a season where relationships are shifting and people are walking away, don't panic. God is making room. He's clearing the atmosphere. He's removing distractions so that when the shift comes, you will not be divided in your focus. Now, let me prophesy something to you. The shift that God is about to make in your life will happen suddenly. But it will not happen accidentally. It will be the result of years of preparation that nobody saw. It will be the result of prayers that nobody heard. It will be the result of seeds that you swed in obscurity. And when it happens, it will look like an overnight success. But you and God will know it was decades in the making. This is what happened to David. One day he was in the field with the sheep. The next day he was standing before Golth. The day after that he was being celebrated by the nation. But what looked like a sudden shift was actually the manifestation of years of preparation. The lions and bears he fought when no one was watching prepared him for the giant. Everyone was watching. So don't despise small beginnings. Don't get frustrated with the process. Don't get discouraged because it looks like nothing is happening in the realm of the spirit. Everything is happening. God is working. Angels are moving. Demonic obstacles are being removed. Divine connections are being orchestrated. And at the appointed time when everything is in alignment, God will shift you from where [music] you are to where you need to be. Let me take you to the book of Exodus. When God was ready to deliver Israel from Egypt, he didn't just show up one day and say, "Let's go." There was a process. There were plagues. There were confrontations. There were demonstrations of power. Why? Because God was not just delivering Israel. He was destroying the systems that had enslaved them. He was breaking the power structures that had oppressed them. He was dismantling the spiritual strongholds that had held them captive. And this is what God is doing in your life right now. Before he shifts you into your promised land, he's dealing with the Egypt in your life. He's confronting the pharaohs that have held you hostage. He's breaking the generational curses that have limited your family. He's destroying the demonic altars that have been speaking against your destiny. So when you see warfare in this season, don't be afraid. When you see resistance, don't be discouraged. When it looks like the opposition is increasing, understand that you are on the verge of breakthrough. The enemy doesn't fight people who are irrelevant. He doesn't waste resources on people who don't pose a threat. The fact that you are under attack is evidence that you are about to be elevated. I'm hearing something in the spirit right now. God is saying that there are some of you who have been in a holding pattern for years. You've been circling the same mountain, fighting the same battles, dealing with the same issues, and you've been wondering, God, when is my season of shift going to come? And the Lord is saying to you tonight is here. The shift has already begun. What you thought was delay was actually divine setup. What you thought was set back was actually strategic positioning. God has been working behind the scenes, arranging [music] things in your favor. People who don't even know you have been influenced to bless you. Doors that were closed are about to open. Resources that were withheld are about to be released. Opportunities that passed you by are about to circle back. The shift is not coming. The shift is here. But here's what you need to do. You need to prepare your mind. You need to expand your capacity. You need to enlarge your expectations. Because if you step into next level blessings with a limited mindset, you will sabotage what God is doing. You cannot carry milliondoll blessings with a minimum wage mentality. You cannot steward global influence with a local mindset. This is what happened to the children of Israel. God delivered them from Egypt and was ready to take them into the promised land. A journey that should have taken 11 days. But they wandered in the wilderness for 40 years. Why? because they couldn't shift their mentality. They kept wanting to go back to Egypt. They kept complaining about the manner. They kept doubting God's provision. They had been delivered from slavery, but [music] slavery had not been delivered from them. Don't let this be your story. When God shifts you, shift your thinking. When God elevates [music] you, elevate your expectations. When God enlarges your territory, enlarge your vision. Don't drag the limitations of yesterday into the possibilities of [music] tomorrow. I'm going to pray with you in a moment. But before I do, I need you to understand something about the authority you carry. You are not a victim of circumstances. You are a voice in the earth. You are not subject to demonic manipulation. You are seated with Christ in heavenly places. You have been given authority to bind and lose, to decree and declare, to open and close. And the shift that God is preparing for you will require you to step into that authority. You see beloved, some shifts will not happen through passive waiting. Some shifts require violent faith. Some shifts require militant prayer. Some shifts require you to open your mouth and decree what God has said even when everything around you contradicts it. You have to learn to speak to mountains. You have to learn to command your morning. You have to learn to prophesy to your future. This is what Ezekiel did in the valley of dry bones. God didn't just show him dead bones and say, "Isn't this sad?" God said, "Prophesy to these bones." In other words, speak life where there is death. Declare possibility where there is impossibility. Call those things that are not as though they were. And as Ezekiel prophesied, the bones began to come together, flesh came upon them, breath entered into them, and what was dead became a mighty army. This is your assignment in this season. You have to prophesy to your dead situations. You have to speak to your dead finances. You have to declare life over your dead dreams. You have to command resurrection where there has been burial. And as you speak, God will breathe on what you say. And what was impossible will become possible. Now, let me pray with you. But before we pray, I need you to [music] position yourself. If you're sitting, stand up. If you're lying down, sit up. This is not a casual moment. This is a prophetic moment. God is about to shift things in the spirit [music] realm. And I need you to be in agreement with what heaven is doing. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne with boldness because of the blood of Jesus. I thank you Lord that you are the God of shift, the God of transition, the God of elevation. You are the God who takes people from the pit to the palace, from the prison to power, from obscurity to influence. And tonight Lord, I stand in agreement with every person who is believing you for a divine shift in their life. I decree right now by the authority of the Holy Spirit that every demonic delay is broken. Every satanic embgo is lifted. Every spiritual stronghold that has held them captive is destroyed. I speak to every pharaoh that has refused to let them go. And I command by the power in the name of Jesus, release them now. Let my people go. I prophesy that every closed door that you have ordained to be open is swinging open right now. I declare that divine connections are being established. I speak that supernatural favor is being released. I decree that they are working out of limitation into enlargement, out of restriction, into expansion, out of delay, into acceleration. Lord, I pray that you will prepare their hearts for what you are about to do. Give them the wisdom to navigate transition. Give them the grace to endure pressure. Give them the discernment to recognize divine moments. Let them not miss their season of visitation. I speak to every area of their life that has been buried and I command fruitfulness. I speak to every dream that has been dominant and I command awakening. I speak to every promise that has been delayed and I command manifestation. Let it be done according to your word, according to your will, according to your timing. I break every course of stagnation. I cancel every assignment of limitation. I destroy every demonic pattern that has kept them circling the same mountain. I declare that this is their season of breakthrough, their season of elevation, their season of manifestation. Father, expand their capacity to receive. Enlarge their vision to see. Increase their faith to believe. Let them not settle for less than what you have prepared for them. Let them not be satisfied with Egypt when you are calling them to Canaan. Let them not be content with the wilderness when you are leading them to the promised land. I pray that you will surround them with the right voices, with prophetic people who will speak life into their situation, who will encourage them when they want to quit, who will remind them of what you said when circumstances contradict it. Lord, I ask that you will give them supernatural strength for this season. Let them mount up with wings like eagles. Let them run and not be weary. Let them walk and not faint. Let your joy be their strength. Let your presence be their confidence. Let your word be their [music] anchor. I decree that they are shifting from glory to glory, from faith to faith, from strength to strength. What they lost in the past season is being restored in this season. What the enemy stole is being returned with interest. What was broken is being rebuked. What was turned down is being established. I speak promotion over their lives. I speak elevation over their careers. I speak multiplication over their finances. I speak restoration over their families. I speak healing over their bodies. I speak peace over their minds. I speak joy over their hearts. Every power that has vowed that they will not succeed, I command you to bow in the name of Jesus. Every demon that has been assigned [music] to frustrate their progress, I bind you and cast you into their bees. Every satanic agenda against their destiny, I cancel it by the blood of Jesus. I declare that no weapon formed against them shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against them in judgment, they shall condemn. This is their heritage as servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is from you. Father, I thank you that this is not just prayer. This is prophecy. This is not just hope. This is declaration. This is not just wishful thinking. This is the word of the Lord. And your word does not return to you void. It accomplishes what you please. And it prospers in the thing for which you sent it. So I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I cover them with your protection. I release angels to go before them and make their path straight. I release the spirit of God to lead them and guide them into all truth. I release the fire of God to consume every obstacle and clear every barrier. Let this be their season of suddenly. Let this be their season of manifestation. Let this be their season of shift. In the mighty, powerful, matchless, excellent name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I have prayed. And every person who has received this word in faith, let them say a resounding amen. Now I want you to do something for the next 40 days. I want you to decree this every morning. This is my season of shift. God is repositioning me for greater glory. Everything that has held me back is breaking. Everything God has promised me is manifesting. I am walking out of limitation into enlargement. I am moving from delay to acceleration. My season of shift is here and I receive it by faith in Jesus name. Say it out loud. Say it with conviction. Say it until you believe it. Say it until the atmosphere changes. Say it until demons tremble. Say it until heaven opens. Because the power of life and death is in the tongue. And they that love it will eat the fruit thereof. You are shifting. You are moving. You are transitioning. And nothing, absolutely nothing will be able to stop what God has begun in your life. This is your moment. This is your season. This is your time. Receive it, walk in it, and become everything God has called you to be in Jesus mighty name. Amen.
